Title: LSJ: Ex nihilo + Theft of Vitae

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
Ex Nihilo
Type: Action
Requires: Necromancy
Cost: 1 blood
+1 stealth action.
[nec] Put this card on this vampire. This vampire gets +1 stealth.
Damage he or she inflicts in combat is reduced to 0, and he or she is
immune to non-aggravated damage. This vampire cannot gain blood; any
blood he or she gains goes to the blood bank instead. During your
master phase, this vampire burns 1 blood or is burned. You may burn
this card during your untap phase.
[NEC] As above, but you may burn this card during any Methuselah's
untap phase.

Theft of Vitae
Type: Combat
Requires: Thaumaturgy
[tha] Strike: ranged. Steal 1 blood.
[THA] Strike: ranged. Steal 2 blood.

Ambrogini Giovanni has an EN on hijm. In combat he plays ToV at THA.
He does not gain, but the opposing minion does burn 2 blood, correct?

Messages.Author: chedcan
Messages.Body:
Regardless of the answer, I'd recommend using a Weather Control / Trap
combo when playing Ex Nihilo in a necromancy/thaumaturgy deck. It
gives better results and is less card intensive than a gazilion Theft
of Vitae.

pretty much. the blood isn't 'burned' as such, i guess. just moved from
the opponent to Ambrogino. But then since Ambrogino can't gain blood, it
is moved to the blood bank instead (card text).

from the rulebook:
Steal Blood. This effect moves blood counters (or life counters) from
the target to the striking minion. This does not count as damage, so the
effect cannot be prevented with damage prevention effects.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <9a7eade0-5277-4290...@m44g2000hsc.googlegroup

s.com>, theghos...@gmail.com writes:
>Sry, but what about a minion with EN and a retainer, such as Zombie?
>The damage from it count as "Damage he or she inflicts in combat"??

That's environmental damage - it doesn't come from the minion carrying
it.

Damage from a specific minion in combat is confined to:
- strikes
- cards that specifically say it's from them (e.g. Twisting the Knife,
Pulled Fangs)

If you have Ex Nihilo and a damage retainer, the damage retainer is
happy to do damage.
